comments.body:
Thanks! I agree errors should be propagated.

This change only partially fixed HTTP errors though. If a snapshot download is already started and it fails half way, a partial file would be left in place. While this isn't a huge problem, I think it'd be nice to clean it up.

I've pushed a change into this PR to make that happen. It downloads into a temporary file first, and replaces the target file if the download completes. If we fail half way, it cleans the temporary file. This also prevents half replacing an existing file on error.
